clubPanel.eventsDesc: Your club's events, and tickets for them
clubPanel.noMembersDesc: Add members to your club to see them here
clubPanel.removeMemberConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove this member? They will lose manager access to this club.

clubPanel.payoutsDesc: Get paid for tickets through Stripe

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.intro: When your club sells tickets, the money goes straight to your club's bank account through Stripe.
payouts.fees: Stripe keeps about 2.9% + 30¢ of each order. Your club gets the rest.
payouts.timing: Stripe sends the money to your bank automatically, usually a few business days after each sale. The first payout can take 7 to 14 days.
payouts.failed: Stripe couldn't be reached. Please try again.

notConnected.label: Not set up
notConnected.description: About 5 minutes on Stripe's secure page: your club's bank account and one officer's ID.

inProgress.label: Almost there
inProgress.description: Stripe needs a few more details before your club can take payments.

payoutsPaused.label: Action needed
payoutsPaused.description: Your club can sell tickets, but Stripe needs more details before it can send money to your bank.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Your club can sell tickets. Payouts reach your bank account automatically.
